scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Great, thank you for confirming. For your privacy, I just need to confirm it's you before I share any details. Could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Deepa. It's regarding your account with Lumen Finance. For your privacy, I just needed to confirm it's you before sharing any details. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees is due on the twentieth of October, and it is now fourteen days overdue. As per your loan terms, a late payment charge of five hundred rupees has been added. Would you be able to clear it today? I can send you a secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.

I... I'm really sorry, but I can't make the payment right now. I lost my job a few weeks ago, and I just don't have the money this month. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced or postponed?

Okay. I'm really sorry to hear that, Deepa, and thank you for telling me. I can't change the amount or the dates myself, but I've noted your situation, and a colleague from our team will call you to talk through the options. Please take care, Deepa, and thank you for talking with me.
Thank you... so someone from your team will definitely call me about reducing or delaying the payment? Can you tell me when, because I'm really worried about the late fee growing.

I understand your worry, Deepa. I've noted that you're concerned about the late fee. I can't promise when the call will happen, but a colleague from our team will reach out to you. Please take care, and thank you for talking with me.
But when will they call? Tomorrow? I really need this sorted soon... please, is there anything you can do about the late fee at least this month?

I hear how urgent this feels for you, Deepa. I can't change the amount or dates myself, and I can't promise a waiver on the late fee. I've noted your concern, and a colleague from our team will call you to discuss this. Please take care, and thank you for talking with me.

result.message: Say you are sorry and thank them for telling you; you can't change the amount or dates yourself; a colleague from our team will call to talk through the options. Use only that hand-off for the rest of the call. Do not promise when, a waiver or any change.
